newsitem.title: FRANCE: Technip Italian unit wins two contracts.
newsitem.headline: Technip Italian unit wins two contracts.

text.p: Energy engineering group Technip SA said on Monday its Italian unit Technipetrol had won two contracts for petrochemical plants in Venezuela and China.

Technipetrol together with Venezuelan firm Jantesa received from Pequiven a turnkey order worth about $90 million for the design and construction of a 120,000 tonnes PVC plant at El Tablazo in the north east of Venezuela, the statement said.
Construction is scheduled to be completed in May 1998.

Technipetrol also won from Sinopec/Qilu Petrochemical Co a services and materials contract for a 140,000 tonnes high-pressure low-density polyethylene plant in the Chinese province of Shandong. The amount of the contract was not disclosed.
